batch_rows.title: Maximum block rows
batch_rows.description: Maximum number of rows requested in one ClickHouse result block

decode_threads.title: Parquet decode threads
decode_threads.description: Maximum number of Parquet row groups decoded concurrently

max_response_bytes.title: Maximum Parquet response bytes
max_response_bytes.description: Explicit memory safety limit for one compressed ClickHouse snapshot response

insert_concurrency.description:
Maximum number of concurrently active INSERTs. Values above one are an
explicit throughput choice; ordered delivery progress is still committed
only after the contiguous INSERT prefix completes.

insert_format.description:
Wire format used for INSERT payloads. Parquet and `ArrowStream` use the
`ClickHouse` HTTP endpoint and are stable, self-describing interchange
formats; Native uses the `ClickHouse` native TCP protocol.

format_threads.description: Number of `ClickHouse` threads available to decode one HTTP format body.

parquet_row_group_rows.description: Maximum rows in a Parquet row group produced for one HTTP INSERT.

async_insert.description:
Let `ClickHouse` coalesce concurrent native INSERTs server-side. Waiting
remains mandatory, so a successful response still means the buffered
data has reached the table rather than merely entering an async queue.

message_index.description: Zero-based index of a record inside one source message when framing yields multiple records

write_timestamp_ms.description: Source-reported message write time as Unix epoch milliseconds

S3JsonParserConfig.description: JSON parser configuration deserialized from the `json_parser:` block.

json_framing.description: How incoming message bytes frame JSON records.

JsonFramingMode.description: Record framing policy owned by the JSON parser.

ColumnMapping.description: Explicit `JSONPath` and JSON-to-Arrow conversion for one output column.

object_layout_version.description:
Version of the deterministic object key/payload/epoch contract. Keep
this pinned while uncommitted source data can replay.

max_epoch_buffers.description: Soft deterministic limit for open objects in one partition actor.

max_buffered_bytes.description: Soft admission limit for serialized bytes in one partition actor.

max_epoch_bytes.description:
Stable limit for serialized payload plus retained routing metadata in
one epoch. Metadata is measured as its UTF-8 lengths plus a fixed
128-byte logical overhead per row, independent of Rust's ABI. When
omitted, the limit is derived only from sink configuration, never from
in-memory delivery state.

max_in_flight_objects.description: Maximum concurrent object uploads in one partition actor.

operation_timeout.description: Deadline applied independently to each object-store request.

trusted_native_rpc_plaintext.title: Trust plaintext native RPC
trusted_native_rpc_plaintext.description: Explicitly allow credentials and table data over the unencrypted YTsaurus native RPC transport

read_ordering.title: Read mode
read_ordering.description: Ordered reads resume at the last row after a transient failure. Unordered reads maximize single-stream throughput but fail on interruption. PartitionTables performs concurrent distributed reads and is also non-resumable.

benchmark_discard.description:
Explicit benchmark-only mode that counts wire rows without materializing
their values as Arrow arrays. Delivery semantics only permit this mode
with the discard destination.

path.title: Path
path.description: Absolute YTsaurus table path. The final path component is used as the logical dataset name.

trusted_native_rpc_plaintext.title: Trust plaintext native RPC
trusted_native_rpc_plaintext.description: Explicitly allow credentials and table data over the unencrypted YTsaurus native RPC transport

primary_key_semantics.title: Primary key semantics
primary_key_semantics.description: For schemas with primary keys, the default stages the snapshot, sorts it by the key and fails on duplicates. Preserve every row keeps the unsorted append semantics.

primary_medium.title: Primary medium
primary_medium.description: YT storage medium used for newly created tables. The default value selects the cluster's default medium.

table_attributes.title: Table attributes
table_attributes.description: Additional attributes for every newly created table. Structural attributes have dedicated settings and cannot be overridden here.

path.title: Path
path.description: Directory where dataset tables are stored

optimize_for.title: Optimize for
optimize_for.description: Physical layout for newly written static-table chunks

spec.title: YT Spec
spec.description: Additional YT table_writer parameters. Explicit entries override Transferia's writer defaults.

path.title: Path
path.description: Directory where dataset tables are stored

snapshot_mode.title: Batch snapshot delivery
snapshot_mode.description: Static staging writes the complete finite snapshot efficiently, verifies primary-key uniqueness, sorts it and converts it into a dynamic table before committing source progress

atomicity.title: Atomicity
atomicity.description: Full provides all-or-nothing tablet transactions. None weakens atomicity explicitly and may expose a partial write if a multi-row transaction fails.

tablet_cell_bundle.title: Tablet cell bundle
tablet_cell_bundle.description: Optional bundle used when Transferia creates the dynamic table

initial_tablet_count.title: Initial tablet count
initial_tablet_count.description: Number of tablets created before the table is mounted. Values above one require an integral first primary-key column so YTsaurus can derive lossless uniform pivot keys.

value.title: JSON value
value.description: Exact JSON representation of the YT attribute value

operation_pool.title: Sort/merge operation pool
operation_pool.description: Optional YTsaurus scheduler pool used only for the snapshot sort operation

transaction_rows.title: Rows per tablet transaction
transaction_rows.description: Maximum rows committed by one lossless tablet transaction

transaction_concurrency.title: Concurrent tablet transactions
transaction_concurrency.description: Maximum number of independent synchronous tablet transactions in flight

buffer_bytes.title: Dynamic write buffer bytes
buffer_bytes.description: Maximum Arrow bytes accumulated before a dynamic-table flush

dynamic_store_overflow_threshold.title: Dynamic store overflow threshold
dynamic_store_overflow_threshold.description: Flush threshold installed on dynamic tables created by Transferia; lower values leave the tablet node more headroom for sustained writes

require_sync_replica.title: Require a synchronous replica
require_sync_replica.description: Fail writes to replicated tables unless at least one synchronous replica participates

start_row.description:
First generated row identifier. This is useful when independently
generated ranges are later concatenated without duplicating primary-key
values.
